sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 4XL.
Target: yourself. Recovers 10 Cost.
Target: yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 3.
Ability Power scales with the number of Neutral elemental Gun type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 5XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
S
Activation rate scales with the number of Neutral elemental Gun type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
